updates.scientific_change: The previously unknown primary kinetic conditions were reconstructed. They reveal a real state-point/media mismatch rather than closing the condition gate.

computational_side.medium_description: explicit TIP3P water; system neutralized with chloride ions; metadynamics used the same basic MD setup

experimental_side.provenance_note: Figure 2 states that the benzamidine relaxation experiment uses the Figure 1 experimental conditions.

updates.next_gate: Find an independent benzamidine association-rate measurement at a condition defensibly matched to the 297 K simulation, or prospectively recompute the barrier/rate at the 290.15 K primary assay state point, or preregister a physics-based condition mapping with uncertainty. No ad hoc rate-derived rescaling is licensed.

updates.mechanism_note: High-level electronic-structure, transition-state-theory, and master-equation treatment includes triplet and singlet channels; the high-temperature singlet branch can form two OH radicals plus O2 rather than behaving as a single scalar termination channel.
updates.calibration_note: The paper reports adjustment of collision, energy-transfer, and state-density parameters in obtaining agreement with observed pressure dependence. Those observations therefore cannot serve as an independent validation target for the adjusted pressure-dependent model.
updates.next_gate: Identify an experiment outside the data used for pressure-dependence adjustment and predeclare the validation regime, or isolate an a-priori low-pressure/high-temperature prediction whose inputs were not selected using that target.

updates.candidate_family: Escherichia coli dihydrofolate reductase hydride transfer
updates.theory_note: EA-VTST/MT QM/MM literature reports a phenomenological activation free energy near 13.1 kcal/mol at about 300 K for the hydride-transfer step.

experimental_candidates.qualification_issue: The 950 s^-1 value is pH-dependent and functions as a kinetic-scheme maximum rather than a single explicitly condition-matched raw state point.

experimental_candidates.observable: single-turnover hydride transfer at pH 7 and 25 C
experimental_candidates.qualification_issue: This is a clean raw kinetic event, but its state point is not automatically identical to the theoretical phenomenological barrier comparator used in the 13.1 versus 13.4 kcal/mol literature comparison.

updates.next_gate: Pin the original EA-VTST/MT calculation conditions and a primary raw hydride-transfer measurement at the same pH, temperature, substrate/cofactor state, and kinetic definition; separately audit whether any model parameters were trained to the same experimental barrier.

updates.classification_note: The reactant disappears by parallel unimolecular paths yielding isobutene + formaldehyde or ethene + acetone, making this a genuine fragmentation candidate rather than repurposing an electrocyclic ring opening.

updates.method_selection_note: The 2012 multi-functional study explicitly states that MPW1PW91 was found to give reasonably good agreement with the experimental kinetics. Selecting that method because of the agreement would violate the campaign selection firewall.
updates.next_gate: Use a method-selection rule fixed independently of the Hammonds-Holbrook target, retain all predeclared method variants as model replicates rather than selecting the best residual, and pin the complete primary bibliographic record before condition-matched adjudication.
